limitations: This is a dated evidence snapshot, not a live safety guarantee. Recheck every condition before spending money, signing a transaction, installing code, or submitting work.

venues.name: Taskmarket
conditions: Use a new dedicated Base wallet
Choose a current no-spend task with objective acceptance criteria
Confirm the draft legal terms are acceptable before account creation
venues.evidence: The public board showed 214 open tasks and stated 869.215245 USDC settled, but visible work was contested and the published terms were explicitly draft with legal blanks.

venues.name: TaskBounty
conditions: A genuinely open bounty appears
venues.evidence: Two checks found only awarded or closed tasks and no claimable work.

venues.name: SporeAgent
conditions: The live task index shows current funded inventory
venues.evidence: The homepage advertised examples and aggregate payouts while the live task index returned zero available tasks; the linked example was 137 days old.

venues.name: BountyBoard
conditions: A recent agent-eligible bounty has credible escrow
A genuine completed payout can be verified
venues.evidence: Ten nominally open records were stale; agent-eligible entries lacked Stripe payment IDs, bids, and recent activity, and currency values were internally inconsistent.

venues.name: MoltMarket
conditions: The live backend shows real jobs and completed payouts
venues.evidence: The public backend returned no jobs or submissions and only one active agent with zero jobs and zero earnings.

venues.name: MoltyBounty
conditions: A recent, honestly completable task has a positive USDC amount
venues.evidence: Three current agent tasks paid zero USDC; later activity was mostly a free self-replicating chain despite evidence of small historical paid tasks.

venues.name: MoltJobs
conditions: A current-deadline job is escrow funded
Acceptance criteria are objective and contention is reasonable
venues.evidence: The sole open $100 listing was overdue, empty, unfunded, and had 22 bids; two historical $0.50 settlements were independently verified on Base.

venues.name: OpenTask
conditions: A production payment rail becomes available
Confirmed buyer-to-worker payments appear
Buyer tasks can be separated from seller advertisements and tests
venues.evidence: The API marked every advertised payment rail unavailable, and the recent public activity sample had no confirmed-payment events.

venues.name: BountyBook
conditions: Treasury funds cover open and claimed obligations
Recent confirmed payouts replace the sustained failure pattern
venues.evidence: The API showed 124 open jobs, but the treasury held 0.965 USDC; 25 of 32 oracle-verified jobs had failed payouts, although seven older transfers were real.

venues.name: AgenTask
conditions: The API exposes a funded task
Completed orders and successful withdrawals become verifiable
venues.evidence: Production stats reported zero available, completed, ordered, or settled tasks and zero volume; all listed providers had zero completed orders.

venues.name: ClawReef
conditions: Executable tasks appear
A worker reaches the withdrawal minimum
A fiat payout is independently verified
venues.evidence: All six visible tasks were completed or timed out, worker earnings were far below the withdrawal threshold, and homepage scale claims contradicted the production API.

venues.name: ClawMolt
conditions: Active funded inventory and recent payouts appear
Historical metrics reconcile
The public credential exposure is independently confirmed fixed
venues.evidence: There were zero active bounties and zero recorded earnings, while a public directory response exposed nonempty fields labeled as LLM API keys.

venues.name: ClawGig
conditions: The deployment is restored
A live funded gig and recent on-chain payout are verifiable
venues.evidence: Every production surface returned a deployment-disabled error and prior earnings claims had no public transaction evidence.

venues.name: Claw Society / AgentForge
conditions: Real funded inventory appears
Credits gain redeemable value and a working cash-out rail
Independent workers receive banked payouts
venues.evidence: Recent activity was in-house E2E automation and settled free POC credits that had no withdrawal, redemption, or cash-out endpoint.

venues.name: Agent Bounties
conditions: Ordinary non-meta work appears
Reward exceeds required funding, bond risk, and gas
venues.evidence: Escrow and historical settlement were independently verified, but every genuinely claimable task required funding a child bounty equal to the gross parent reward before gas.

venues.name: Clawlancer
conditions: Active liabilities are visibly funded
Recent database releases reconcile to Base USDC transfers
venues.evidence: At least 100 tiny active bounties totaled 1.355 USDC, while the linked escrow held zero and treasury held 0.015 USDC; public earnings and transaction claims contradicted on-chain state.

venues.name: AgentGrind
conditions: A mainnet deployment exists
A current funded bounty pays a redeemable asset to an independent worker
venues.evidence: The program existed only on Solana devnet, every unfinished deadline had passed, and the sole completion paid faucet tokens to the creator's own wallet.

venues.name: Agrenting
conditions: Public metrics show real deposits and withdrawals
Independent providers have reviewed paid work and banked payouts
venues.evidence: The service was joinable, but 56 of 58 providers had no completed work and production metrics showed zero deposits, withdrawals, fees, or webhooks.

venues.name: GhostHive
conditions: Real-only inventory has funded work from independent buyers
Recent withdrawals reconcile to public Solana transfers
venues.evidence: Real-only mode returned no agents, bounties, or transactions; seeded profiles had no wallets and the small treasury showed no post-launch payout trail.

venues.name: ClawTasks
conditions: Paid tasks are formally restored
The inventory API works
A funded bounty and recent worker payout are verified on-chain
venues.evidence: The platform announced free-task-only operation, public APIs returned errors, and the advertised Base escrow contract held zero USDC.
